method: gd30_valcmp.py: same valley (dark line) detector on the reference panel and on Blender clay renders in the solved cameras; profile mapped onto the reference with the tip + subnasale similarity; probe = mean position of the strongest valley line; diff = model - reference (row probes: - = model higher; column probes: - = model further forward)
units: mm (model scale via px per mm at the nose)
